questions.question: How much solar generation did the California ISO curtail in September 2026, in MWh?
questions.answer: CAISO curtailed 163,494.64 MWh of solar in September 2026 (iso_curtailment_monthly, derived, CAISO's own curtailment figure, summed over the month). The figure may understate the month. The share_hours_held figure for the month is 696 hours, against 720 hours in the month (both from iso_curtailment_monthly). I can't confirm from the table whether those 696 hours are the same hours the 163,494.64 MWh covers.
